about.quote: Technology is a means, not an end my focus is solving real business problems through good user experience.
about.body1: With over 8 years developing web and mobile products using React, React Native, and TypeScript, I've worked across different contexts: retail within the Fintech tribe at Magalu, tourism, fintech (EqSeed, Finnet), and international e-commerce (Samsung Latin America, via Trinto | Digital Partners).
about.body2: My main focus is front-end, but I also have back-end experience with Node.js, MongoDB, and PostgreSQL, which helps me communicate better with the whole team and propose more complete, end-to-end solutions.
about.body3: I also dedicate part of my career to technical mentorship. I take as much pride in helping other developers grow as in the code itself.

featured1.name: Cartão Magalu / SuperApp Magalu — Luizalabs
featured1.shortDesc: Integration of Cartão Magalu into SuperApp, eliminating the need to leave the app to check the statement.
featured1.fullDesc: Worked within Magalu's Fintech tribe on a project to facilitate access to statement data (transactions, closing, due date) of Cartão Luiza within the SuperApp Magalu. This had a significant impact on customer retention within the app, eliminating the need to access another application. Also contributed to a Backoffice tool for the fraud and operations team, a new Landing Page for Cartão Magalu (with annual fee, cashback and discount information), and the MiniApp MagaluPay — an umbrella architecture that allows team autonomy for independent business features.
highlights: Webview with FAQ and card information

featured2.name: Investment Platform Restructuring — EqSeed
featured2.shortDesc: Complete front-end restructuring of an investment fintech, with simulator and payment flows.
featured2.fullDesc: Responsible for restructuring the front-end architecture of EqSeed's investment platform, focusing on scalability, performance, and maintainability. Created a solid foundation in Next.js with TypeScript, Styled Components, and ESLint. Implemented critical features such as the investment simulator, settlement and payment flow (credit card, PIX, QR Code) and receipts, working collaboratively with product, design (Figma/Design System), and marketing.
highlights: Payment flow: card, PIX, QR Code

featured3.name: Samsung Latin America Sites — Trinto | Digital Partners
featured3.shortDesc: High-performance custom applications for Samsung sites across Latin America on VTEX IO.
featured3.fullDesc: Contributed to the development of projects on the VTEX IO platform, targeting Samsung sites across Latin America. Worked on the conception and maintenance of custom applications with React and TypeScript, implementation of JavaScript middlewares for communication with Master Data, styling leadership (CSS/Sass), and onboarding of new team members.
highlights: Custom apps in React + TypeScript on VTEX IO
